title: Fabrication of potential environmentally friendly 3D printing biocomposite filament based on poly(lactic acid) and cellulose fibers from agricultural waste
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10346-10362
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09705C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Chi Thanh, Pham Duc Thinh, Bui Phuong Dong, Tran Hai Cat, Nguyen Thanh Huy
The biocomposite based on PLA and cellulose was developed using an environmentally friendly process. This approach meets the increasing demand for bio-based materials in 3D printing, supporting the development of a circular and sustainable economy.
